candidate_source: The same candidate packet hash and source selected for the two completed 1.7B and DistilGPT2 comparisons
score: Flashlight accumulated acoustic score plus exact completed-candidate neural natural log likelihood multiplied by the tuning weight. KenLM remains an acquisition prior only.
weight_selection: Minimize corpus edit count on the existing dev_tune allowlist, tie by smaller weight.
precision: Qwen BF16 on one A100 with FP32 reduction, no offloading
rationale: The repaired beam-250 oracle at 50 candidates dropped below 10% on dev_tune. Compare one stronger official base model under the identical 25-candidate contract used in the primary fixed rescoring conditions.
